issues.explanation: The draft claims the harbor signal gate first closed before it first opened, but the cited record says it first opened at 09点 and first closed at 10点.

evidence.excerpt: At 09点 on the same day, the harbor signal gate first opened and had never closed before then. At 10点 on that day, it first closed after opening.
